ios.desc:
WorkUnion connects project owners, contractors, builders, and agencies with skilled and verified construction workers across India. Whether you need masons, carpenters, electricians, plumbers, painters, helpers, bar benders, or finishing workers, WorkUnion helps you source reliable labour quickly and manage your workforce in one place.

FOR CONTRACTORS & BUILDERS
- Post jobs and receive applications from verified workers
- Browse worker profiles with skills, rates, availability, ratings, and work history
- Assign workers to project sites and manage site-wise deployment
- Track attendance with GPS and selfie-based check-in and check-out
- Approve attendance, review daily work logs, and view site progress photos
- Manage wage and payment records with clear, transparent history
- Access dashboards, reports, and analytics for your projects

FOR WORKERS
- Create a verified profile with your skills, rates, and availability
- Find and apply to nearby construction jobs
- Mark attendance with selfie and GPS proof
- Upload documents and maintain your work portfolio
- Track your earnings, work history, and ratings
- Get notifications, message contractors, and raise support requests

WHY WORKUNION
- Faster labour sourcing compared with informal hiring
- Structured, verified worker profiles instead of unverified walk-in labour
- Site-wise attendance and daily work visibility
- Cleaner records for wages, attendance, and deployment
- Support for both short-term and project-based workforce needs

WorkUnion brings transparency and digital workflow to construction labour management, reducing delays from labour shortages and manual coordination.

Support: support@workunion.in
Website: https://www.workunion.in
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

android.desc:
WorkUnion connects construction contractors with skilled laborers across India instantly and reliably.

FOR WORKERS:
• Browse and apply for construction, plumbing, electrical, and skilled labor jobs near you
• Get hired by verified contractors in your city
• Track your daily attendance (Hajri) digitally — no more paper registers
• View your earnings and work history in one place
• Build your professional profile with skills and experience
• Chat directly with contractors about job details

FOR CONTRACTORS:
• Post jobs and find verified, skilled workers in minutes
• Manage your entire team from one dashboard
• Track daily worker attendance with digital Hajri
• Review worker profiles, ratings, and past work history
• Chat with workers before hiring
• Manage multiple sites with ease

WHY WORKUNION?
• 100% verified profiles — no fake workers or contractors
• Built specifically for India's construction industry
• Works in Hindi and English
• Simple interface designed for all literacy levels
• Secure OTP-based login — no password needed
• Free to use for workers

Whether you're a mason, electrician, plumber, welder, carpenter, or site supervisor, WorkUnion is your platform to grow your career and income.
Contractors: Stop relying on middlemen. Find trusted workers directly.
Workers: Stop waiting at nakas. Find work from your phone.
Join India's fastest growing construction workforce platform today.

quotes.text:
I’ve been building software for the last few years, mostly working directly on products rather than just doing small freelance tasks.

Web apps, mobile apps, backend systems, payments, real-time systems, admin panels, deployments, the whole thing. Some of the products I’ve worked on are already live.

But honestly, right now things are a little quiet. I don’t have any active client work, and I’m looking for the next thing to work on.

So if anyone here has a project that needs a developer, needs help finishing something, or knows someone looking for a Software Engineer / Full Stack Developer, I’d genuinely appreciate you reaching out.

I’m comfortable taking something from an existing codebase and fixing/building it, or starting something from scratch.

Some of my work (https://vijeetshah.com/):
